attributes.facts: "{'found': True, 'event': 'kb_answers', 'answers': [{'question': 'What if I forget to wear the HeartBug device?', 'short_answer': 'Put the device back on as soon as you remember and try to wear it at all times so it can monitor your heart properly.'}, {'question': 'What happens at the end of my monitoring period?', 'short_answer': 'When monitoring ends, place the device in the prepaid return envelope and post it. Your recordings are then reviewed and a report is sent to your doctor.'}, {'question': 'How do I know if the device is working correctly?', 'short_answer': 'Use “See My Heart” in the app (or ask me) to view a live trace. If you can’t see the trace or the app shows no connection, contact patient care.'}, {'question': 'What if my monitoring period needs to be extended?', 'short_answer': 'Speak with your doctor if you need more monitoring — they can request an extension, and HeartBug will arrange extra time or supplies. Extra costs may apply in some cases.'}, {'question': 'What should I do if I have to remove the HeartBug device early?', 'short_answer': 'If you remove HeartBug early, contact Patient Care so they can notify your doctor. If you removed it due to irritation, follow the skin care steps.'}], 'score': 0.792}"
attributes.tts: "You can follow the instructions that came with the HeartBug device, and if you want to check it’s working, use “See My Heart” in the app for a live trace; if you can’t see one or it shows no connection, please contact patient care."
